text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein attacks usurpers and vows to punish them.
- Iraq holds Saudi Arabia and Kuwait responsible for U.S. warplanes violation of its airspace.
- UAE says sanctions on Iraq have left strategic vacuum in the Gulf.
- Egypt calls for the immediate implementation of Iraq's food-for-oil deal with U.N.
- Jordanian security forces prevent striking workers from gathering in front of the offices of a power company in Amman.
- The U.S. is facing new international developments which will eventually lead to its isolation.
- Iran deploys offensive weapons in UAE islands it occupies
- Saddam allocates 31 million dinars for the renovation of the headquarters of Iraqi Writers Union.
